Security Objective: Identify risks to the confidentiality integrity and availability of ePHI
Current State: A risk assessment exists but is not updated on a consistent schedule
Evidence Expected: Risk analysis report and risk register
Recommended Action: Perform and document a formal risk analysis at least annually and after major changes

Security Objective: Reduce identified security risks to reasonable and appropriate levels
Current State: Risk treatment actions are tracked inconsistently
Evidence Expected: Risk treatment plan and remediation records
Recommended Action: Create a formal risk treatment process with owners timelines and closure evidence

Security Objective: Assign responsibility for HIPAA security oversight
Current State: A security lead exists but responsibilities are not fully documented
Evidence Expected: Security role description and responsibility matrix
Recommended Action: Document HIPAA security ownership and responsibilities

Security Objective: Ensure workforce access is appropriate based on job duties
Current State: Role-based access is implemented but recurring reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Access review reports and approval records
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly workforce access reviews

Security Objective: Limit access to ePHI based on minimum necessary principles
Current State: Access controls exist but some permissions are broader than required
Evidence Expected: Role matrix access approvals and review records
Recommended Action: Review ePHI access and remove unnecessary permissions

Security Objective: Provide recurring security awareness training to workforce members
Current State: Annual security training is provided
Evidence Expected: Training completion reports
Recommended Action: Continue annual HIPAA security awareness training and phishing simulations

Security Objective: Maintain procedures for identifying and responding to security incidents
Current State: An incident response plan exists but tabletop testing is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Incident response plan and tabletop exercise reports
Recommended Action: Conduct annual incident response tabletop exercises

Security Objective: Maintain backup disaster recovery and emergency operations procedures
Current State: Backups and recovery plans exist but testing is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Backup logs disaster recovery plan and test reports
Recommended Action: Perform recurring contingency and recovery exercises

Security Objective: Periodically evaluate the effectiveness of security controls
Current State: Security reviews occur but are not formally scheduled
Evidence Expected: Security assessment reports and review calendar
Recommended Action: Establish a recurring HIPAA security evaluation schedule

Security Objective: Ensure vendors handling ePHI are appropriately evaluated
Current State: Business associate agreements exist but recurring security reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: BAAs vendor questionnaires and reassessment records
Recommended Action: Perform annual security reviews of high-risk business associates

Security Objective: Limit physical access to systems containing ePHI
Current State: Cloud providers manage most physical access controls
Evidence Expected: Cloud provider physical security reports and attestations
Recommended Action: Review provider physical security documentation

Security Objective: Protect workstations that access ePHI
Current State: Endpoint protection and screen-lock policies are implemented
Evidence Expected: Endpoint policy and workstation configuration evidence
Recommended Action: Continue monitoring workstation security compliance

Security Objective: Control disposal and reuse of devices and media containing ePHI
Current State: Disposal procedures exist but evidence is incomplete
Evidence Expected: Device disposal logs and media sanitization records
Recommended Action: Document secure disposal and media sanitization evidence

Security Objective: Restrict access to ePHI systems to authorized users
Current State: Role-based access controls are implemented
Evidence Expected: Access control configuration and user access records
Recommended Action: Continue periodic access validation

Security Objective: Assign unique user IDs for accountability
Current State: Unique user accounts are required
Evidence Expected: Identity records and user account inventory
Recommended Action: Continue enforcing unique user identification

Security Objective: Ensure authorized emergency access to ePHI is available
Current State: Emergency access procedures exist but testing is limited
Evidence Expected: Emergency access procedures and test evidence
Recommended Action: Test emergency access procedures annually

Security Objective: Record and examine activity in systems containing ePHI
Current State: Centralized logging is enabled
Evidence Expected: SIEM dashboards audit logs and log source inventory
Recommended Action: Continue monitoring audit log collection

Security Objective: Review security and access logs for suspicious activity
Current State: Logs are collected but review evidence is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Log review records and incident tickets
Recommended Action: Document recurring audit-log reviews and investigations

Security Objective: Protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction
Current State: System controls and backups support integrity protection
Evidence Expected: Integrity controls change logs and backup evidence
Recommended Action: Continue monitoring data integrity controls

Security Objective: Verify the identity of users accessing ePHI
Current State: MFA is enabled for some privileged and remote accounts but not all
Evidence Expected: MFA configuration and authentication policy
Recommended Action: Require MFA for all privileged and remote access accounts

Security Objective: Protect ePHI transmitted across networks
Current State: Encryption is used for data in transit
Evidence Expected: TLS configuration and network security documentation
Recommended Action: Maintain approved encryption standards
